description: Turn out-of-office (automatic replies) on, off, or schedule it. Status "scheduled" requires scheduledStart and scheduledEnd. Requires the MailboxSettings.ReadWrite permission.

externalAudience.description: Who outside the organization receives the external reply (default: none)

externalReplyMessage.description: Reply sent to people outside the organization (HTML supported)

internalReplyMessage.description: Reply sent to people inside the organization (HTML supported)

scheduledEnd.description: End of the scheduled window as an ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. "2026-08-14T18:00:00Z"); explicit offsets are converted to UTC, zone-less values are treated as UTC

scheduledStart.description: Start of the scheduled window as an ISO 8601 date-time (e.g. "2026-08-10T09:00:00Z"); explicit offsets are converted to UTC, zone-less values are treated as UTC

status.description: "alwaysEnabled" turns automatic replies on until changed, "scheduled" turns them on between scheduledStart and scheduledEnd, "disabled" turns them off

name: set_automatic_replies
